sources.title: Large-scale detection of multilingual coordinated activity on Telegram
sources.verification: Opened full primary article and searched Methods.
sources.supports: Monolingual identical-message threshold .99; EN-RU .90; .7 initial tuning, .05 increments; 2-day pair-search windows distinct from posting-time constraint. DR4 .70 near-identity summary is wrong.

sources.title: Coordinated link sharing on Facebook
sources.supports: Data-adaptive exponential and negative-binomial mixture thresholds;27seconds;frequency around9;do not transfer blindly across contexts. Exact frequency comparator should be checked against implementation before reuse.

sources.title: Misinformation and professional news on largely unmoderated platforms: the case of telegram
sources.verification: Opened full primary article in Helsinki university repository; inspected abstract, Methods, limitations and results.
sources.supports: Selected mostly US-focused news source links 2018-2019; sharing and views are different outcomes;no overall misleading-content views superiority. Reach is views/participants, not deduplicated humans.
